metadata.article_title: Release of one co-surety does not discharge others.

article.title: Release of one co-surety does not discharge others.
article.content:
138Release of one co-surety does not discharge others.

Section 138  ·  Chapter VIII  ·  page 37 of the Act
Where there are co-sureties, a release by the creditor of one of them does not discharge the others; neither does it free the surety so released from his responsibility to the other sureties1.
1 See s. 44, supra.
